name: Prague PostgreSQL Developer Day 2027
description: PostgreSQL community conference with a workshop day and a talk day
place: Faculty of Information Technology, CTU (ČVUT FIT)
note: on-site; mostly English talks (some Czech); late-January event every year
dateNote: 2027 dates not announced; last edition 27-28 Jan 2026
details:
P2D2 is the yearly PostgreSQL developer conference in Prague, run at the Faculty of Information Technology of the Czech Technical University: day one has workshops and trainings, day two 45-minute talks in parallel tracks.

The 2026 (18th) edition drew more than 300 participants with most talks in English. The official site still shows the 2026 edition; the 2027 date, CfP and prices are not out yet.
